summary: KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC filed an 8-K reporting that certain indirect subsidiaries entered into an Amended and Restated Revolving Credit Agreement on September 11, 2026 with Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation as administrative agent and KKR Capital Markets LLC as joint lead arranger. The facility was increased by $100 million to $1.325 billion, with an accordion expanded by $1.0 billion to permit up to $2.5 billion; pricing on Term Rate, Daily SOFR, and Base Rate loans fell 50 basis points, with LTV-based and default step-ups; maturity extended to September 11, 2029 from December 23, 2027. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
